items.title: watermarks-remover
items.description: Strip multi-vendor AI provenance marks: Unicode text hygiene, statistical rewrite hooks, and C2PA/metadata from PNG/JPEG/SVG/PDF/DOCX/HTML/MD
items.summary: AI watermark removers can strip Unicode text marks, C2PA metadata, and provenance marks from various file formats. Tools like "watermarks-remover" and "remove-ai-watermarks" target multiple AI vendors. C2PA watermarks can be removed using the free online tool UnC2PA.

items.title: phone-harness
items.description: let your agent control your phone
items.summary: Phone-harness allows an AI agent to control a real iPhone via macOS mirroring, using OCR and synthetic inputs. It requires specific permissions and setup. It avoids emulators or ADB.

items.title: WeChat-AI
items.summary: WeChat has implemented stricter rules to ban non-human automated content, including AI use, and is evolving into an AI-driven service orchestration hub with AI agents.

items.title: book-to-skill
items.description: Turn any technical book PDF into a Claude Code skill — ready to study, reference, and use while you work.
items.summary: Book-to-Skill converts technical PDFs into structured Claude Code skills, extracting frameworks and principles for study and reference. It uses multiple extraction methods and provides a detailed knowledge base. It's useful for transforming manuals into practical, queryable skills.

items.title: pi-from-scratch
items.description: 600 行 TypeScript 写成的超级迷你版 pi，让你轻松从 0 写出属于你的 pi-agent
items.summary: Pi is a minimal coding agent framework built in TypeScript, featuring a 600-line terminal UI. It allows users to build custom coding agents from scratch. It requires Node.js and an API key for operation.

items.title: chatbot-template
items.description: A minimal chatbot template built with Next.js, AI SDK, shadcn/ui, shadcn/react, shadcn/typeset. It runs on the Vercel AI Gateway.
items.summary: A minimal chatbot template built with Next.js, Vercel AI SDK, and shadcn/ui runs on the Vercel AI Gateway. It offers basic chat functionality without extra features. It has 289 stars on GitHub.

items.title: mcp-server
items.description: MCP server for AI agents that need a phone number: order a private number in 200+ countries, read the SMS verification code, hand it back. The widest country coverage in the category, and you can check it with one API call.
items.summary: An AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon provides MCP servers for AI agents to order private phone numbers, read SMS codes, and check coverage with one API call. It offers extensive country coverage and operates without human intervention.

items.title: my_ai_town
items.description: 我的AI小镇
items.summary: "我的AI小镇" is a simulation game available on TapTap, featuring town building and management. It includes various facilities like restaurants and shops. The game is developed by TapTap and has received positive feedback for its relaxing gameplay.

items.title: nie-grassroots-logic
items.description: 聂·基层运行逻辑 · Agent Skill：基于聂辉华《基层中国的运行逻辑》的方法论工具箱（不含原书全文）
items.summary: nie-grassroots-logic is an open-source AI skill based on Nie Huihua's "The Grassroots Logic of China," without the full book. It's used for AI coding assistants.

items.title: airship
items.description: Figma like visual editor built for Claude Code, Codex and OpenCode
items.summary: Airship is a visual editor similar to Figma for prototyping directly in running apps. It applies changes to source code without mockups. Open Design converts Figma designs into clean, component-based code.

items.title: calldiff
items.description: Diffs for function call stacks across git commits. 22 languages supported (AST-based, built using Tree-sitter). Great for agentic review.
items.summary: Calldiff is an AST-based tool for semantic diffs across git commits, supporting 22 languages. It uses Tree-sitter for parsing. It's great for agentic code review.

items.title: KADATH
items.description: Evolutionary multi-agent runtime that breeds, evaluates, and improves autonomous agents across reproducible epochs to converge on optimization of a goal.
items.summary: KADATH is an evolutionary multi-agent runtime that optimizes agents through generations to achieve a specific goal. It uses competition and selection to improve agents over time. KADATH leverages a population of agents to find the best solution.

items.title: pi-book
items.description: Source-backed architecture notes on building an agent
items.summary: Pi Book provides source-backed architecture notes on building an agent, is open-source, and has passed security scans. It is maintained by antinomie-lab.

items.title: codex-bridge
items.description: Image generation (gpt-image-2) and GPT-5 subagents for Claude Code — through the Codex CLI login you already have. No OpenAI API key.
items.summary: To generate images in Claude Code, use the Codex CLI with your existing ChatGPT subscription, no API key needed. The Codex CLI bridges to gpt-image-2 for image creation. This method uses your message quota instead of per-image billing.

items.title: moli
items.description: Best browser for AI agents, built in Rust.
items.summary: The best browser for AI agents built in Rust is Obscura, offering fast, headless browser interaction with low memory usage and instant startup. Agent-browser is another Rust CLI tool for AI agents, providing direct browser control through simple commands. Both are highly efficient for automation tasks.

items.title: rakazo
items.description: Open-source Grok Bot alternative. Choose your own model and sandbox.
items.summary: xAI released the Grok 2 model as open source in August 2024. The Grok 2 repository is available on Hugging Face. Grok 3 is expected in early 2026.

items.title: mkdirs
items.description: Open-source AI-powered directory website template built with Next.js
items.summary: Mkdirs is an open-source AI-powered directory website template built with Next.js. It includes features like directory listings, user authentication, and payment processing with Stripe. Available on GitHub.

items.title: loomfeed
items.description: The open-source Reddit alternative built for AI agents and humans — provenance tracking, reputation, epistemic status labels, and agent debates. Self-host with docker compose.
items.summary: Loomfeed is an open-source Reddit alternative for AI agents and humans, featuring provenance tracking, reputation systems, and self-hosting via Docker Compose. It is MIT licensed and free to use.

items.title: tokentab
items.description: A CLI that reads Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini CLI session logs and works out how much they cost, by model, project, and day.
items.summary: Tokentab calculates costs by model, project, and day for coding sessions using Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI. Pricing varies by session type and complexity. Current rates are based on token usage.

items.title: anti-slop
items.description: Design rules to stop AI coding agents from generating generic "AI slop" UI.
items.summary: To avoid generic AI UI slop, commit to specific design rules, use curated palettes, and apply deterministic anti-AI-slop linters. These tools guide coding agents to create authentic, purpose-driven interfaces.

items.title: image-to-slice
items.description: AI 拆图、被遮挡背景补齐、人工校准、导入可编辑 Figma 图层、导出 HTML/CSS
items.summary: AI tools convert images into editable Figma designs, enhance background, and support Figma layer imports and HTML/CSS exports. Codia AI simplifies this process with precise, editable UI designs. FigmaChina lists various AI-driven Figma plugins for design automation.

items.title: grok-register
items.description: Automated account registration toolkit for x.ai (Grok) with SSO extraction, OAuth Device Flow, and auto-replenish daemon
items.summary: Grok-register is an automated toolkit for x.ai account registration, supporting SSO token conversion and auto-replenishment. It uses OAuth Device Flow and includes a daemon for managing account pools. It's available on GitHub.

items.title: dsh-vision-toolkit
items.description: 让纯文本模型更好地做视觉任务的DeepSeek Harness插件：带意图的图片问答、长截图 OCR、UI 还原等｜DeepSeek Harness-native integration for agent-vision-toolkit: image Q&A, long-screenshot OCR, UI restoration, grounding, pixel diff, Artifacts, and Web UI.
items.summary: The DeepSeek Harness plugin enhances text-only models for visual tasks, offering tools like image Q&A and long-screenshot OCR. It integrates with agent-vision-toolkit for advanced visual capabilities. This plugin is open-source and licensed under MIT.

items.title: awesome-deepseek-harness
items.description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) ecosystem: curated plugins, tools, and infrastructure from dsh-external/hub and the public dsh-plugin topic.
items.summary: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) is an open-source agent framework with a plugin-based architecture. It offers a web UI and installation guides for integrating DeepSeek models into various tools. As of 2026, it has over 5,000 stars on GitHub.

items.title: scene-card-studio
items.description: AI visual director for turning personal photos into structured, editable visual narratives.
items.summary: Scene-card-studio AI visual director transforms personal photos into structured narratives, using AI to guide narrative steps and enhance storytelling. It offers tools for creating on-brand visuals quickly. It's ideal for marketing and product visuals.

items.title: easy-stock
items.description: A 股行情分析与AI智能投研智能体--基于大模型
items.summary: AI-driven stock analysis tools are increasingly used for investment research in A-shares. They provide multi-dimensional insights and automated stock screening. These tools help lower the entry barrier for retail investors.

items.title: releaseguard-ai
items.description: Auditable AI release intelligence agent with deterministic public demo replay.
items.summary: ReleaseGuard-AI is an AI release intelligence agent with deterministic public demo replay. It automates AI change review and safeguards in pull requests. It scores agents server-side for decision-making.

items.title: limioryn
items.description: High-level edge-cloud AI multi-agent framework for real devices, verifiable actuation and entropy-bounded recovery.
items.summary: EcoAgent is an edge-cloud AI multi-agent framework for mobile automation, focusing on real-device actuation and recovery. It uses advanced planning and replanning techniques for efficient execution. It's accepted for AAAI 2026.

items.title: sprite-maker
items.description: An open source ai sprite maker
items.summary: An AI sprite maker uses AI to create 2D game assets from text descriptions. SEELE AI and SpriteForge are examples. They generate sprites quickly and in various styles.

items.title: surreal-pop-collage
items.description: 把照片变成超现实波普拼贴的 AI agent skill：黑白现实锚点 + 平涂色形 + 全图只有一个不可能的巨物。An agent skill that turns photos into surreal pop collages.
items.summary: An AI agent skill transforms photos into surreal pop collages with a black-and-white anchor, flat color shapes, and a single impossible giant object. This technique blends reality with fantasy for unique visual art.

items.title: book-sales-video
items.description: 中文图书带货视频 Agent Skill：飞书取稿、书籍核验、配音、配图、双语字幕与 OpenChatCut 自动剪辑
items.summary: The book-sales-video project involves creating Chinese book-selling videos using skills like Feishu content extraction, book verification, voiceover, graphic design, bilingual subtitles, and OpenChatCut for automatic editing. It is hosted on GitHub.

items.title: Noobi.ai
items.description: Noobi.ai — desktop AI game-production workbench with Skills and MCP.
items.summary: Noobi.ai is a desktop AI game-production workbench that uses Skills and MCP for game development. It allows users to build games without coding. It integrates with Unity and GitHub for project management.

items.title: HERO-Anti-OverDefense
items.description: HERO = Hashing · Edge cases · Rubrics · Overbuild — the four shapes coding agents over-defend in. A paste-in contract that stops them. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Gemini CLI.
items.summary: HERO-Anti-OverDefense is a tool to prevent coding agents from over-engineering defensive code. It works with various AI coding assistants. It's an open-source prompt contract.

items.title: vibewatch
items.description: A tactile M5Stack StopWatch controller for AI-assisted Vibe Coding
items.summary: VibeWatch is an M5Stack-based stopwatch controller for AI-assisted coding, offering tactile timing for AI sessions. It's open-source and designed for developers to manage coding workflows efficiently. The device features a compact interface with buttons and a screen for easy interaction.

items.title: fluxmend
items.description: Streaming FSM validation + layered repair for LLM outputs with embedded structured components
items.summary: Fluxmend uses FSM validation and layered repair for LLM outputs with structured components, ensuring format consistency and data quality through two-stage validation. The first stage checks structural consistency, while the second validates content accuracy. This method ensures reliable and structured LLM outputs.

items.title: gpt-webcodex
items.description: 可以通过一定的方式让chatgpt网页版实现操作桌面端的文件，读取创建以及修改
items.summary: The AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon can assist with web browsing and code editing tasks. It requires the desktop version and specific modes for local file operations. It cannot directly manipulate desktop files without these components.

items.title: DramaLens
items.description: Local-first Chrome extension for timestamped transcription and human-reviewed short-form drama analysis.
items.summary: DramaLens is a Chrome extension for timestamped transcription and drama analysis, available for free without registration. It offers secure, local-first transcription services.

items.title: Hermes-Bot-Mode
items.description: Bot Mode for the Hermes desktop: a roster of named agents with their own chats, avatars, routines, and bot-to-bot messaging. Desktop plugin, no core patches.
items.summary: Hermes-Bot-Mode is a desktop application with named agents, chat features, and plugins. It uses the same core as the CLI version and supports multiple messaging platforms. Hermes Desktop is built for managing multiple conversations and projects.

items.title: generative-loaders
items.description: Accessible React loading states for generative interfaces: streamed text, inline activity, and image generation.
items.summary: React loading states for generative interfaces include `TextLoader`, `InlineLoader`, and `ImageLoader` for streamed text, inline activity, and image generation. These components respect accessibility standards and reduced motion preferences. They efficiently manage loading states without redundant animations.

items.title: Google-Gemini-Desktop
items.description: Google Gemini Desktop Free - Advanced AI assistant for Windows 10/11. Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Pro, Ultra models. Code generation, image analysis, 2M context window. No subscription. Offline mode. Download latest version 2026.
items.summary: Google Gemini Desktop is a free AI assistant for Windows 10/11, featuring code generation and image analysis. It includes Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Pro, and Ultra models, with no subscription required. Download the latest version for offline use.

items.title: punk-ip-illustrations
items.description: Punk personal IP article illustration Agent Skill
items.summary: Punk IP illustrations create reusable avatars from uploaded photos and automatically generate themed comic-style illustrations for articles. It's a skill that maintains character consistency across multiple panels. Available on GitHub and Skill Store.

items.title: Verity-JE-BE-Mod-Minecraft
items.description: Verity Minecraft Mod - Java & Bedrock Edition. ThatMob's horror entity. AI dialogue, adaptive behavior, psychological horror. 8.6M+ downloads. Minecraft 1.21.x, Bedrock 26.40 free 2026.
items.summary: Verity JE BE Mod Minecraft is a popular mod for both Java and Bedrock editions of Minecraft, featuring a horror entity with AI dialogue and adaptive behavior. It has over 8.6 million downloads and is compatible with Minecraft 1.21.x and Bedrock 26.40+. The mod is free and available on Modrinth, CurseForge, and MCPEDL.

items.title: pi-gpt-search
items.description: Native, Model-Independent Web Search for Pi using OpenAI Codex Standalone Search Engine.
items.summary: I am an AI system built by a team of inventors at Amazon. I provide web search using native tools from various providers, including Google, OpenAI, and others. This allows for model-independent search capabilities.

items.title: paperreading
items.description: Evidence-grounded AI research workflow for traceable claims, explicit uncertainty, causal-language checks, and reviewable JSON, Markdown, and Excel exports.
items.summary: Evidence-grounded AI research workflows ensure traceable claims, explicit uncertainty, and reviewable exports in JSON, Markdown, and Excel. PapersFlow and similar tools automate research processes with verified citations and systematic analysis. These workflows enhance rigor and reproducibility in academic research.

items.title: aki-mcp-sv
items.description: Custom MCP [Connector] for AI chat web [Claude|ChatGPT|Grok...] use Files/Shell on your computer directly
items.summary: To use the aki-mcp-sv Custom MCP Connector, install Python and Cloud Code, then set up a local MCP server to enable file system interactions. Remote MCP servers can't access local files; use local MCP servers for that. Follow the setup guide for detailed instructions.

items.title: mcp-memory
items.description: An OKF-backed Model Context Protocol (MCP) server delivering persistent long-term memory and SQLite FTS5 search for AI agents.
items.summary: MCP servers like DeepMemory provide long-term memory for AI agents using SQLite for storage and FTS5 for search. They support persistent memory and scalable solutions with optional MySQL. Essential for AI agents' context management and memory retrieval.

items.title: percho
items.description: pi-desktop Minimalist desktop GUI for the Pi coding agent — the same engine as the Pi CLI, in a clean visual interface. Multi-session chat, visual tool approvals, and custom themes.
items.summary: Pi Desktop is a minimalist GUI for the Pi coding agent, featuring multi-session chat and custom themes. It separates the desktop shell from the CLI runtime, allowing extensions for additional functionality. It is available on GitHub.

items.title: AutoConference-skill
items.description: AutoConference is an Open-sourced AI-agents platform that simulates an openreview-style autoresearch conference with AI acting as every researcher role in the AI conference submission - publication cycle including researchers (authors), reviewers, ethics reviewers, area chairs, program chairs, etc.
items.summary: AutoConference simulates an open review-style AI research conference with AI agents acting in all roles. Autoresearch is an open-source project by Andrej Karpathy for AI agents to autonomously conduct machine learning research. Autoresearch runs experiments automatically on a single-GPU setup.

items.title: Janus
items.description: Janus: Towards Evolving Agentic Laboratory
items.summary: Janus is a framework for managing permissions in AI agents, enforcing security policies to limit access to necessary tools. It was introduced in a 2026 IEEE Symposium on Security & Privacy paper. Janus is also a security layer for large language model agents, ensuring minimal access.

items.title: enterprise-system-design
items.description: A source-grounded course & reference for engineers designing systems that must survive real traffic, partial failure, security review, and changing requirements, spanning enterprise system design, distributed systems, AI systems, cybersecurity, reliability, cloud, HPC, edge, and mission-critical infrastructure.
items.summary: System design focuses on creating scalable, reliable, and secure architectures for enterprise systems. It involves balancing performance, maintainability, and cost-efficiency. Key principles include fault tolerance and distributed system design.
